content:
Victor Huang: Rolling canary for serving v6.0.0 in 12m (03:45 UTC). plan: 5% -> 20% -> 60%. paid routes pinned to v5.9.7.
Zoe Kim: Confirming pin to v6.0.0. Rollback target: v5.9.7. I'll prep the release notes but hold until canary clear.
Ben Carter: Request gating: block promotion if OOMs or memory_pressure events > 2 in 10m OR p95 increase > 200ms for 3m. Also require no node restarts.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: rollout scheduled at 03:45 UTC for serving v6.0.0. Auto-revert disabled for first 15m per request. Monitoring hooks: telemetry, node-health, trace-sampler.
ops-oncall: Who holds delegate rollback authority first 30m?
Victor Huang: ops-oncall primary. release-manager standby to coordinate comms.
release-manager: I'll draft the outward-facing blurb and a one-line customer FAQ in case we need to pause.
Ben Carter: Rollback commands (canary only / global):
```
# canary rollback
/ops/release revert --service serving --to v5.9.7 --scope canary
# global rollback
/ops/release revert --service serving --to v5.9.7 --scope global
```
Zoe Kim: Also add step to invalidate model cache after revert: `/infra/modelcache invalidate --services serving --regions all`
deploy-bot: Canary shift started -> 5% to v6.0.0. Baseline: p95=130ms, error_rate=0.02%, node-restarts=0, mem_pressure=0.
ops-oncall: Monitoring dashboards. :eyes:
deploy-bot: Canary telemetry (03:48 UTC): p95=145ms, mem_pressure events=1, node-restarts=0.
Ben Carter: Keep an eye on worker memory growth on gpu-pool-3. If we see >1.5x baseline resident mem, pause.
ops-oncall: Noting memory growth on worker-12. Resident memory up 1.6x baseline. Opening bridge to triage.
Victor Huang: Pause promotion immediately. ops-oncall you have authority to revert canary if node-level memory pressure persists.
ops-oncall: Collecting a few traces and jstack dumps, then reverting.
ops-oncall: Traces show allocator thrash leading to evictions and near-OOM logs. Executing canary revert now:
```
/ops/release revert --service serving --to v5.9.7 --scope canary --confirm
```
deploy-bot: Revert acknowledged. Traffic shifting off v6.0.0 back to v5.9.7 for canary.
ops-oncall: Revert complete. Canary at 0% for v6.0.0. Node memory normalizing; no restarts.
Zoe Kim: Hold release notes. Message should say: "Canary paused due to memory pressure in internal tests; paid customers unaffected. Investigating."
release-manager: Draft ready: will post to #customer-updates after product review.
Ben Carter: Follow-ups: add memory_pressure counter to gating, surface worker IDs in alerts, add a preflight smoke that runs a long-lived allocation test. I'll open PRs.
Victor Huang: Assign postmortem and runtime ticket: Ben, take the runtime ticket; ops-oncall attach traces and jstacks. I'll hold reattempt authority until we verify fixes.
ops-oncall: Attaching logs to ticket now. Observed allocator backtraces and a few eviction warnings.
Zoe Kim: Thanks everyone. After revert p95 back to baseline (128ms). Closing bridge in 15m unless objections.
Victor Huang: Closing loop: manual canary revert executed, canary pinned back to v5.9.7, release notes paused. Reattempt after memory fix and a new smoke run. Great coordination. :white_check_mark:
